description: Agent Waste and Recycling Records: submit a pickup and collection log with the service record and manifests it answers to: each account the service record lists with its id, account reference and route; each pickup log entry with its id, reference, account, route, hauler, waste type, quantity collected, the moment picked up, its status (completed, missed or rescheduled) and the missed pickup it makes up; each waste manifest with its id, manifest number, the pickup it ships and the quantity. The signed report gives the pickup log and the records behind it, each pickup’s account and route against the service record, each missed pickup against the reschedule or completion entry behind it, each pickup’s quantity against the manifests naming it, and each entry against a date, a hauler and a waste type, and counts them, and names divergent pickup logs: a pickup logged on a route or account the service record does not list, a missed-pickup entry with no reschedule or completion entry behind it, a pickup quantity the manifest record does not reflect, and a log entry missing a date, a hauler or a waste type; then a completed pickup with a quantity and no manifest behind it and a manifest naming a pickup the log does not hold, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No pickup log entries, no service record beside entries that name an account or route, or no manifests beside logged quantities leaves those points unverified. Accounts, routes, pickups and manifests match by letters and digits, quantities read to the hundredth, a missed pickup is resolved by an entry naming it or a later completed pickup on its account, and an entry with no status reads as completed. This reads the waste collection log for a route or a service area: the pickup log check reads whether every waste pickup ran on a listed account and route, every missed pickup was made up and every collected quantity was manifested. Verdict waste_pickup_log_divergent, waste_pickup_log_partial, waste_pickup_log_unverified or waste_pickup_log_consistent. POST /api/waste-pickup-log-check. Reads the waste and recycling records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it hauls no waste, operates no facility, contacts no regulator, hauler or disposal site and issues no permit or certification, which stay with the waste operation, its haulers, its facilities and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Waste and Recycling Records reads a waste operation’s own records: waste manifest records, hauler permit records, disposal and landfill records, recycling processing records, diversion and recovery records, pickup and collection log records, facility and scale records and contamination report records, each against the hauler permit, facility, receiving and disposal records, the waste types, areas and dates in the pickup log, the manifests and the dates the record states, the inbound, outbound and residue records, the processing, reuse, disposal and pickup totals, the service record, the scale tickets and dispositions, or the follow-up entries and the inspected load counts on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the waste stream: what the manifest shows, what the disposal record supports, what the permits cover, and whether the diversion claims and pickup logs hold up; it reads records about waste streams and the people who move them, not live environmental monitoring and not cleanup services: the Agent Energy family reads utility and generation records, the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s production records, the Agent Food Safety Records family reads a food business’s safety file and the Agent Aviation Records family reads an air operator’s flight and maintenance paper trail, while this family reads a waste operation’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-waste-recycling-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-waste-recycling-records/.
